summary_en: BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. raised its takeover offer price for Kakaku.com to 3,597 yen per share, or 3,720 yen if a non-tender agreement with KDDI (holding 17.55%) is concluded. All regulatory clearances have been obtained. The tender offer will commence once Kakaku.com's board approves and recommends the bid.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Amendment to Announcement of Scheduled Commencement of Tender Offer for Kakaku.com Inc. by BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P.
translation_en_brief:
BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P., advised by Bain Capital Private Equity and partially funded by LY Corporation (LINE Yahoo), announced an increase in its tender offer price for Kakaku.com Inc. (2371) to 3,597 yen per share. If a non-tender agreement is successfully concluded with KDDI Corporation, which currently holds 35,016,000 shares (17.55% of outstanding shares), the price will increase to 3,720 yen. Under the proposed non-tender arrangement, KDDI would abstain from tendering its shares, subsequently participate in shareholder approval for a stock consolidation to facilitate going-private procedures, and accept a share buyback by Kakaku.com after the consolidation is completed.

All regulatory clearances required for the tender offer have been completed as of the announcement date of September 16, 2026. The bidder intends to commence the tender offer promptly upon receiving Kakaku.com's board approval and recommendation to shareholders. This development follows earlier price increases announced by competing bidder Kamgras 1, which raised its offer price to 3,680 yen per share on September 10, 2026. The special committee established by Kakaku.com to evaluate the going-private transaction has provided a favorable opinion regarding the target company's board resolution to express support for and recommend the BCPE tender offer to shareholders.
